# cogen

> cogen (`@mazinsw/cogen`) is a CLI code generator. It parses a MySQL `CREATE TABLE` schema, where column and table comments may carry extra metadata as bracketed commands like `[N:Display name]` or `[S]`, and renders every file of a template directory once per table (or once overall) using a `$[level.property]` tag language with `if`/`each`/`else`/`end` blocks. Template files may end in `.cgn`, which is stripped from the output name.

Key facts for writing templates:

- Tags: `$[table.norm]`, `$[Field.name]`, `$[field.each(~ignored)]...$[field.end]`, `$[field.if(number)]...$[field.else]...$[field.end]`. The casing of the level word (`table`, `Table`, `TABLE`) sets the output casing.
- A line break right after a block tag is dropped; spaces before a block tag are kept, so put block tags at column 0.
- `$[...]` in a template path generates one file per table; field tags in a path generate one file per field.
- Names are singularized/pluralized with `pt-BR` rules by default; pass `--lang en` (or `lang=en` in a `.properties` project file) for English schemas.
- At table level `$[index.each]`, `$[unique.each]`, `$[foreign.each]`, `$[constraint.each]` iterate keys; nested inside a key they iterate its fields.
